notes.title: 🎉 Introducing the 8 going on ∞ Update! 🎉
notes.content:

[b]8 is the magic number[/b] in this update, and we're bringing you some new features to keep things fresh from here to infinity! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/112ac8c5a6142b7ceb3192d7e69d5caffa6cbf94.png[/img]

🏆 [b]Eight time's the charm! [/b]
From March 14th to March 28th, we're rewarding players for every 8th round won during online play! That's right, not matches, but rounds! Stay sharp, because after every 8th victorious round, you'll receive a random item that you don't already own. You can do this [b]up to 8 times a day[/b], so keep those wins coming!

🔥 [b]Top Tier Tweets! [/b]
If you manage to clinch [b]8 consecutive match wins[/b], you'll earn yourself a spot in the limelight! Win 8 times in a row and we’ll shout you out on Twitter, for posterity. Just remember, this time it’s matches, not rounds!

notes.title: Welcome To Secret Santa’s Workshop! Don’t touch anything!!
notes.content:
Remember kids, Secret Santa is watching you at ALL TIMES. He knows when you’ve been nice, but especially when you’ve been naughty, and what are the Holidays for if not sharing! 

Brace yourselves for another instalment in our Secret Santa Saga. Ho, Ho, Hope you’ve been honing your skills cuz winners get cookies while losers get dirty hands and a chance to GIT GUD! 

[h2][b]Introducing Secret Santa's Festive Familiars! [/b][/h2]

These little floating [b]Familiars [/b]will hang around your character during rounds, keeping them company through the mayhem.  Are they there to help or are they just surveilling on behalf of Secret Santa? Well, we made them so cute that you just won't care! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/23b196d370668d6a796d61d29dd4f165e9a7986f.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Now that we got you're attention, here's how it all works! [/b][/h2]

To get in on the action, all you have to do is [b]play Move or Die during our Holiday Special spanning December 21st to January 4th. [/b]

[h2][b]Spend not-coins on Festive Familiars[/b][/h2]
Spend your hard earned not-coins on a Festive Familiar from Secret Santa’s personal stash. Each familiar has its own price and[b] you can only purchase them 4 times per day.[/b]

[h2][b]Buy Milk and Cookies for Santa [/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/5d7d09a1f7eb9174db0f72c2dbbdc0e42b7b0c56.gif[/img]

Buy Milk and Cookies to bribe Secret Santa and [b]get an in-game item of random rarity.[/b] They can be game modes, mutators or characters, but take care. Santa is famously stingy, so [b]he’ll charge you increasingly more with each transaction! [/b]

[h2][b]You get coal for losing, but can exchange it for goodies once per day[/b][/h2]

Losing makes Santa sad, so with every round you lose, you'll get increasingly more Coal. Luckily, you can exchange it for items from the Not-A-Store. [b]This transaction is only available once per day, so spend your coal wisely! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/d3a385347f5deb3bb44a25fa68f153d1749f7f41.gif[/img]

To conclude, Secret Santa is making his list, checking it twice, and your gaming prowess will determine if you've been naught or nice. Good luck and let the jolly chaos unfold! 

Team MoD

notes.content:

So grab your shades, slather on some sunscreen, and let's jump right in!

Two new sun-kissed characters make their debut in the form of an unruly ice cooler and a very entry-level swimmer:

Actually, if you stop to think about it, 7 years is actually A LOT for a little indie title like ours. One could even argue that 7 years in game years is like 68 in real-life. So with no further ado, please enjoy our [b]geriatric-themed anniversary update![/b]

notes.title: Taking a breather this Holiday Season with the Too Cozy To Care winter update!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

With so much going on all the time, caring is getting to be a bit of a chore, especially during the holidays. That’s why, for this winter update, we’re tuning out the trauma and opening up our hearts to all things cozy! 

From cuddles to hot cocoa and perfectly fitting snuggies, this update is all about kicking back and taking a breather while the world goes to heck around us. 

First of all, we have a [b]tender trio of cozy characters[/b] you should all get to know! 
[list][*] [b]Brady[/b], the spa loving sloth with a heart of “not caring about your problems.”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/90a75daded5926f4c3e8de63fdd5dcdd102ce1df.gif[/img] 
[/list][list][*] [b]Blanket[/b], you average hot cocoa enjoyer that simply can’t be bothered

notes.title: This fall, we Splice It Up with our Halloween Mini-Update!
notes.content:
As the leaves do their thing and seasonal depression sets in, we wanted to mix things up a bit for our yearly [b]Halloween Update[/b]. And by “things” we definitely mean body parts. 
 
Please give a warm welcome to our latest seasonal special - [b]The Splice It Up Mini-Update![/b] 
 
So there’s this doctor, right? And he likes to take a little bit of this and a little bit of that and then put everything back together in no discernable order, like if Humpty Dumpty was operated on by Frankenstein. Some of the good doctor’s ensuing monstrosities have somehow escaped and are now on the loose, terrorizing average Joes. The least you can do is get to know them, maybe that’ll give you some sort of upper hand: 
 
[list]
[*] [b]Sharkmera[/b] is what happens when you cross a shark, a fly and uhm… a couple of other things. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/03c8eb8eaa4ac47576c7d2464338bf38c5f040fe.gif[/img]
[*] [b]Mouthclops[/b] is a failed experiment in seeing if you counteract morning breath with bedroom eyes. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/35c3617994ff05aff4b2b16c87c6b38e76e492fd.gif[/img]
[*] [b]Constraintine[/b] had a fear of missing out that tragically turned into a reality of missing parts.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/062eaf738ff4ee57064dc9cb0ca8573d260801e3.gif[/img]
[*] Last but not least, [b]Swampear[/b] is what happens when you ask the wrong person to “grow a pear.” 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/9ec6570c607f21a27569de8ec1a83b64c359bb5a.gif[/img]
[/list]
 
We’ll go out on a limb and guess you’ll have a blast losing friends and causing mayhem in these skins. 
As with every Halloween update, we’ve also given [b]Move or Die[/b] a monstrous makeover, complete with pools of blood, sinister sounds and pictures that you’ll see in Rorschach form for years to come! 

There are creepy cosmetics to be had, with items such as [b]DNA trails[/b] and [b]Chalk Outline death splatters[/b] up for grabs as soon as the update goes live. And as an extra treat, we're bringing all the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/323850/view/3342248989450729958][b]Dead by Daylight Collab[/b][/url] items back in rotation, just in case you missed them the first time around. You can do this if you play an online match between [b]October 25th, 10 AM PDT - November 8th, 10 AM PDT[/b].

 
Thanks for stopping by and stay tuned for more awesome news to come. 

- Team Move or Die 🐔

notes.title: Move or Die and Dead by Daylight present: the Thrill of the Hunt Update!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey there buds or shall we say survivors? 😱[/h1]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/83f5add0d954339ab85daca7ea744c3cc98cb7ab.gif[/img]


This summer, [b]Dead by Daylight[/b] and [b]Move or Die[/b] try to play nice together in the aptly dubbed [b]Thrill of the Hunt Update[/b]! Surprised? Careful, that’s one of the first steps in getting yourself murdered. 

Here’s what you’ll find or, more probably, what may find you in this killer collaboration! 


[h1][b]Killers on the loose[/b][/h1]

This wouldn’t be much of a guest appearance without us giving the ol’ [b]Move or Die[/b] makeover to some of [b]Dead by Daylight[/b]’s creepiest killers… plus [b]Genny[/b]! You can now bump in the dark, especially when playing with the Lights Off mutator, against certified slayers like [b]Trapper, Huntress or Blight[/b], but also sigh in relief at the sight of [b]Genny[/b], a lighter addition to our roster.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/35d58534d427ad4b9211e5343add50b342459f0f.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/85e8ec0c9832e8ece965bed80b510e3a641f5fbd.gif[/img]

For more info on everything we've added, tweaked, fixed, and made spooky:
[url=https://www.moveordiegame.com/patchnotes]👉 Head over to our patchnote list![/url]

Before we say goodbye, we’d like to thank the awesome people at [b]Dead by Daylight[/b] for making this crossover update possible. For a bunch of stone-cold killers, they seem really nice. 


Now go out there and make a killing! 
See ya in the bloody lobby \o
[b]- Team Move or Die[/b]

notes.title: Is this thing cursed? Check out our NEWEST GAME MODE - Pandora’s Blast!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hey there![/b][/h2]

We teased you, now it’s time to please you! It's been a cool minute since we last came up with a new game mode ,but now it's time to deliver. [b]Pandora's Blast[/b] is ready to make its big Move or Die debut starting today! Let’s take a peek inside, shall we?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/ea17d59d5228098436a2db63a115eb9054fc11c0.png[/img]

[h1][b]A tale tailor-made for troublemakers[/b][/h1]

It all started with our [b]6-Year Adventure[/b], which like the past actual year, quickly turned kind of grim. As our four trouble-seeking protagonists went about their yearly anniversary tour, they found themselves blundering about an ancient temple. One thing led to another and one of them, most likely Count, couldn’t help themselves and opened the [b]mysterious Pandora’s Box[/b]. This promptly led to every evil breaking free into the world starting with the damned box itself. Some of these evils are worse than others, with a few even taking Joe form and finding their way into [b]Move or Die[/b]. 

[h1][b]The all seeing eyes of ouch![/b][/h1]

The gist of the curse is straightforward. To survive Pandora’s wrath all you have to do is hide from her all-seeing eyes and evade their beams of death. The last Joe standing is spared and gets to declare himself the winner. If it sounds a bit unnerving it’s because it is: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/143c7560adca885ac38c5a8f0c8ddf11d0879276.gif[/img]

To get this [i][b]new Rare-rated game mode[/b][/i] all you have to do is provide the appropriate amount of Not-Coins and enjoy the havoc. 

Another thing worth mentioning is that the [b]drop rates for game modes and mutators has been tweaked [/b]since the 6 Year Anniversary Update rolled out and we’d really appreciate the community’s input on this change and if it’s been noticeable so far. Please let us know in the comments or on our dedicated Discord channel. We're really trying to find a good balance for this, that makes the unlocks feel rewarding for everyone involved. 

[h1][b]A silver lining for a sinister curse[/b][/h1]

Now, preaching all doom and destruction can get a little dull, so here are a few positive things we can look forward to in the following months.  

Another [b]great game-mode[/b] is in the making that we’re pretty sure you’ll absolutely die for. It’s a [b][i]bona-fide killer[/i][/b]! Make sure you join our [url=discord.gg/moveordie][b]Community Discord Server[/b][/url] to get the latest news, and while you’re at it why not make some game-mode suggestions of your own? We’ve made a [b]“game ideas” channel[/b] specifically for this, so check that out too - [b][url=https://discord.gg/uDx2Vs5Hrr]Join the Discord Game Suggestion Channel[/url][/b]

Last but definitely not least, get your thinking-chicken-caps ready for [b]The Community Character Collaboration (contest)[/b]! We’re opening submissions for new Move or Die characters and are in dire need of dumb ideas. Make sure to check out our Discord server because all the details, as well as submissions themselves, will be posted in the [b]#character-collab[/b] channel - [b][url=https://discord.gg/aJMTEsRn2m]Join the Discord Community Character Collab Channel[/url][/b]

[url=https://discord.gg/aJMTEsRn2m][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/6679178905c21a5a345de820214fdd48d7ed6e7a.gif[/img][/url]

That’s it for now but stay tuned for other exciting friendship-ruining announcements!
[b]- Team Move or Die  [/b]

notes.title: NEW UPDATE! - 6 Year Anniversary Update for Move or Die!
notes.content:
Hey there gang!

Remember that last update where we made a ton of promises? Those sounded good, right? Well, we came to deliver with the [b]MOVE OR DIE 6th ANNIVERSARY UPDATE! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/20c369f83441c63200f58172ba79f91616c8811b.png[/img]

That's right, some of you die-hard fans have been playing our party game for [b]6 whole years[/b]! Time sure flies when you're having fun! Doesn't it just fill you with existential dread? Now, let's all calm down a little bit and finally get back to addressing those promises that we made. 

First of all, we finally have a [b]new game mode[/b] in the pipeline!!! It's not launching today, as we're still doing some last minute balancing and testing, but you shall be able to play it [b]very soon[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/7b3e5aed9e6e863a862d17f94047d9738c2cf1a7.gif[/img]

Complementing the new mode, we have the titular [b]Pandora’s Box[/b] as a character! This box loves making people miserable, and hopefully you can use it to make your friends hate you even more than they already do. I mean, that's the point of the game right?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/9520bd47162cef0d7aaf345b22f324df08c71ef3.gif[/img]

You can get [b]Pandora's Box[/b] by simply playing an online match during the next couple of weeks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/eada806a5fdc64112ecd5914a220a103de4a52be.gif[/img]

But the box ain’t all, as we have a whole slew of [b]new characters[/b] coming to the [b]Community Debt Unlock Bar[/b]! Some quick spoilers below, for your personal enjoyment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/9a76334221550f10c262c804a563e73d15e7299f.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/c3c85d93ab75e3016c94ac6f6e2152bdc8cca34f.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/6c498eaf2e2b89afee7b7be34bf735ab176c57fd.gif[/img]

Wow, we are really getting stuffed with characters, huh? And speaking of the [b]Community Debt Bar[/b], remember all of last year's characters? Well, since you've most likely missed some of them, we're giving you a second chance. All of the 2021 released cosmetics will now be available in the [b]Not-A-Store[/b] and [b]Bid Wars[/b] rotation.

Of course, this means a new Daily Contribution season is starting today, so your previous progress has been reset.

As promised, there's a whole lot of [b]bug fixes and quality of life improvements[/b] that we plan on bringing to the game in 2022. This update will contain the [b]first set of changes[/b] that we think will make the game more stable and enjoyable. To check out the most recent changes, please head on out to the [url=https://moveordiegame.com/patchnotes][b]Patch Notes[/b][/url] page on our website.

Thank you for sitting through all that, we appreciate your time and hope it was worth it. 

To reward all your hard work, here's a [b]sneak peek at what’s coming next[/b], later this year:

notes.title: The Act Like It’s Christmas Mini-Update! The stage is set!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/c7187ee0201a6028ba3d93e2f85029de361fd5f1.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/c960ca21ff2e4f276d2e6d3f1cff688c4170902d.png[/img]

For 2022, while the speed at which we bring updates to the game might slow down a bit, we are 100% committed to bringing at least[b] 3 new game modes[/b] (that are already in development) as well as [b]a handful of new mutators[/b], to make them even more crazy. 

In 2022, we're also dedicated to [b]fixing a lot of the longstanding issues and bugs[/b] that have been plaguing the game for the last couple of years. Yes, this includes such classics as the [b]Shuriken Parry issue[/b], [b]the infamous audio glitch[/b], as well as a slew of other stability issues for all platforms ([b]Linux included[/b]).

notes.title: LA FIESTA LATINA MINI-UPDATE - New Move or Die Celebration
notes.content:
[h1]Hey there, friends![/h1][/b]

Even though 2021 has so far been another year of mostly in-door activities, our plan to bring Move or Die to as many audiences as possible for our [b]5th Anniversary Journey[/b], is still very much right on track.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/323850/Move_or_Die/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/0ee141bcd04e1b17728d87d35d58a9f54e75b92f.png[/img][/url]

While earlier this year, our main characters traveled through mainland China, to bring everyone the [i][b]‘’Lunar New Year Mini-Update'’[/b][/i], the time has finally come for us to make a pit stop in lovely Latin America!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/6f0fbafd756762f8dce89cc7d1af95ba007e2789.png[/img]

With the [i][b]‘’La Fiesta Latina Mini-Update’’[/b][/i] we plan on taking another look at the [b]Brazilian Portuguese[/b] and [b]Argentinian Spanish[/b] localizations that are currently in the game, while also spicing things up with a couple new character skins that we know you’ll love to pick in your friendly brawls both on the couch and online.

Thus, get ready to meet [b]Al[/b], the traveling Alpaca; [b]Nada[/b], the snackable tango dancer and [b]Jo[/b], the tactical ball! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/1dbba05e0673fc4f4f0ee9eeb2eb3c66b2736472.jpg[/img]

[b]Al[/b] is a pretty laid back dude. That could be either because he is originally from a country with “Chill” in its name or because, generally, alpacas dislike drama. He might also spit on you for no reason, but don’t take it personally. It’s just because he likes you a whole lot.

[b]Nada[/b] is full of life and bursting with excitement (and beef). Though sometimes she might seem a little too hot to handle, you can rest easy knowing that her crusty exterior hides a warm heart and a whole lot of flavor.

[b]Joseph Gabonito[/b] (also known as Jo to their friends) works hard and plays hard. In their spare time, they like to kickback, relax and just roll with whatever the day throws at them. Though beloved by millions around the world, Jo can’t help but feel that sometimes people just hang around them for kicks and giggles.

These [b]three characters[/b] will be unlockable through the [b]Community Debt Bar[/b] system. So get online and play a couple of rounds of the [b]Community Debt Challenge[/b]! As this is a community wide effort, every small bit of contribution counts. Once unlocked, the characters will be available to keep for all players, forever!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/609a7c18385327dd815424b8156c1a035073b317.png[/img]

As per usual with these [b]localization mini-updates[/b], we greatly appreciate your feedback on any potential language typos, grammar mistakes or any other bugs that you might consider to be relevant or outright annoying.

Thank you oh so much for being part of our [b]2021 world wide adventure[/b]! See you at the next checkpoint!
[b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/4b0abda0b9bbe9ef068f298c760903efc5496090.png[/img]

notes.title: Addressing Apple’s lack of support for 32-bit apps on its latest macOS 10.15
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6909713/a9fc66690203872c187df71ae32eda02d1211b91.jpg[/img]

With the recent release of its latest [b]macOS 10.15[/b], Apple has officially renounced support for 32-bit applications. As you may or may not know, this is also the case for [b]Move or Die, which will no longer be available to play on macOS Catalina devices[/b]. Unfortunately, trying to fix this situation is simply not feasible on our part, the reasons why being among the following:

[list]
[*] The lack of support for 32-bit apps on [b]Catalina[/b] would require us to rebuild the game's engine as 64-bit and also fix any issues that might crop up along the way.

[*] We've also developed Move or Die on an old version of the [b]Love2D[/b] engine, with a bunch of custom options. Because of these options, switching to a newer version of [b]Love2D[/b] would require a lot of work which we have decided against in the past due to lack of time and resources.

[*] [b]Love2D[/b] also uses many other libraries. Going 64-bit is likely to break some of them and while upgrading those libraries to their newer versions would help with the 64-bit transition, this could also cause horrible compatibility issues.

[*] Then, there's also the [b]OpenGL[/b] issue. Apple hasn't completely killed off [b]OpenGL[/b] support, but they have announced that they are phasing it out to support their Apple only [b]Metal API[/b]. Unfortunatelly, [b]Love2D[/b] heavily depends on [b]OpenGL[/b].
[/list]

That being said, for [b]any Apple user that will not be making the switch to macOS 10.15 Catalina, Move or Die will continue to work as intended.[/b]

Obviously, we know that this is not an excuse and that it is a big issue for people who do still decide to update, or for those who will be purchasing new Apple products in the years to come.

We will make sure that these compatibility issues are properly explained and highlighted on the [b]Steam Store Page[/b].

Thank you for supporting us ever since [b]Move or Die[/b] came out in [b]Early Access[/b] in 2015. Back then, we promised to always keep our game open, updated and available on all PC platforms and we have managed to do so without flaw.

It seems that this time, we have reached a point where things are just out of our reach.

See you in the lobby! 

- Those Awesome Guys Team

[url= http://www.moveordiegame.com/updates/communitychest][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6909713/9b8a4de640e843b8bb6e40a6c9ba59b4115903c9.png[/img] [/url]

Hya there!

This might be a daring thing to admit in times of GDPR compliance hysteria, but we’ve been listening. We’ve been listening intently and we have just the thing to prove it – a whole new update focused on all the wants and needs of our awesome community, neatly bundled up in a chest you don’t have to pay for.

[h1][b][url=http://www.moveordiegame.com/updates/communitychest] Introducing the all new Community Chest Update![/url][/b][/h1]

You wanted performance improvements and a more optimized experience, you got it! You wanted to see more of your designs and suggestions make it into the game, well… have at it! We even added 3 new characters loosely based on your antics. This is just the icing on the cake in terms of what this update has in store, but rest assured that everything is baked specifically to the community’s questionable taste. 

Here’s what you made us do:
[list]
[*] [b]PERFORMANCE IMPROVEMENTS[/b] – Smoother than a baby’s bottom
[*] [b] BRAND NEW CHARACTERS[/b] – Millard the modder, Techie the tester and Archie the achiever.
[*] [b] NEW COMMUNITY–SOURCED MUTATORS[/b] - Velcro, Dirty Shoes, reworked Ghostly Jumps.
[*] [b] NEW LEVELS[/b] – may or may not be straight up boosted from the Level Building Contest.
[*] [b] NEW CONSUMABLES[/b] – New Splatter, New Flammable Head and a new Emote.
[/list]

https://youtu.be/J1Lx7C3MjCs

So there you have it, a whole new update dedicated entirely to you, the real MVPs. Now go on and try it out for size!

Have a great one,
~pasho

notes.title: New Patch - Version 9.0.2 is out
notes.content:
Hey Tide fans,

We're working on optimizations and small changes since the 2 Year Adventure Update and this weekend we pushed a patch witch a bunch of fixes.

Thanks for all the reports and submissions. Even if we don't reply to each and every one of you, we're taking a look at everything.

[b]Here are the notes for Patch 9.0.2 released on the 3rd of February:[/b]

[list]
[*] The last used trail is now remembered
[*] The host will now auto-kick himself during a match if he is idle for too long
[*] Fixed a rare crash during the "Hoops" game mode while using the "Flammable Head" consumable
[*] When you gain Not-Coins, a new "+ Value" graphic appears above your current Not-Coins
[*] Even further improvements to the steam item conversion system
[*] Prevented the top bidder's username from overflowing in the Bid War screen
[*] Improvements to trail networking
[*] Properly removed trails when you clear a player slot in a lobby
[*] Fixed a loophole that allowed you to exit the Not-A-Store screen without enough items activated
[*] Fixed a silly problem where clicking on the "Bid War" would cause the following pop-up to disappear as well
[*] Prevented the game from applying the last used character/trail if you disabled them in the Not-A-Store
[*] Password protected servers are not disappearing anymore from the server browser

As always, you can check any patches or updates on the [url=http://www.moveordiegame.com/patchnotes][b]Move or Die Website[/b][/url]

Keep being awesome

~finch

[/list]

There’s also a bunch of tweaks and other small changes that you can read about in our [url=http://www.moveordiegame.com/patchnotes]patch notes[/url].

On a more heartfelt note, thank you for sticking around. It means the world to us and then some.

notes.content:
[url=http://www.moveordiegame.com/contest][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6909713/8df46921215789847b706632974c3f1ed2c6399a.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]Hey there people who still write 2017 in the date field.[/h1]

Let's put that holiday belly to work with something really exciting.

Introducing the 
[url=http://www.moveordiegame.com/contest][h1][b]MOVE OR DIE LEVEL BUILDING CONTEST[/b][/h1][/url]

We see you guys already know the modding way [b][url=https://i.imgur.com/nDGQ2pr.jpg]pretty well[/url][/b], so we figured it's time for an actual challenge.

In the [b][url=http://www.moveordiegame.com/contest]Level Building Contest[/url][/b] we want you to make a Move or Die Level Pack consisting of at least [b]5 Levels[/b].

Here's how to enter:
[list]
[*] [url=https://youtu.be/yNEqVQOHvc4]Watch this video[/url]
[*] [url=http://www.moveordiegame.com/LevelBuildingKit.zip]Download this Level Mod Kit[/url]
[*] [url=http://www.moveordiegame.com/modding/]Check out the modding wiki[/url]
[*] [b]Make 5 levels, one of which has to be a SpeedRun one.[/b]
[*] Submit your levels as one mod in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/323850/workshop/]Steam workshop[/url] page of Move or Die
[*] Tweet [url=https://twitter.com/someawesomeguys?lang=en]@someawesomeguys[/url] using the hashtag [b]#modcontest[/b] & link to the steam workshop page of your mod
-OR-
[*] Post the link on the Those Awesome Guys [url=https://www.facebook.com/ThoseAwesomeGuys/]Facebook page[/url], and mention @MoveOrDieGame in your Facebook post.
[*] Brag to your friends
[/list]

We will select 3 winners that will receive prizes based on their standings and overall quality. Any level or level pack that we consider amazing will make it into the game (as an official level), even if it wasn’t one of the winning 3!

The top 3 prizes are:
[list]
[*] 1st Place: [b]500 USD, a Move or Die 4 Pack and Yourself as a Hidden Character In the game[/b]
[*] 2nd Place: [b]200 USD, a Move or Die 4 Pack and your design for a trail in the game.[/b]
[*] 3rd Place: [b]100 USD and a Move or Die 4 Pack.[/b]
[/list]

[b]The Submission Deadline for this contest is the 17th of January at 23:59 GMT. Submit your entry before then.[/b]

Make sure you go through the official [b][url=https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/s/93lq9zw22ecare0/MoD%20Level%20Contest%20Legal.pdf]contest rules[/url][/b] to find out if you're eligible to enter.

Here's where all your minecraft experience comes in. Show us what you gooot!

~finch

[url=http://www.moveordiegame.com/contest][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6909713/8df46921215789847b706632974c3f1ed2c6399a.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]Hey there people who still write 2017 in the date field.[/h1]

Let's put that holiday belly to work with something really exciting.

Introducing the 
[url=http://www.moveordiegame.com/contest][h1][b]MOVE OR DIE LEVEL BUILDING CONTEST[/b][/h1][/url]

We see you guys already know the modding way [b][url=https://i.imgur.com/nDGQ2pr.jpg]pretty well[/url][/b], so we figured it's time for an actual challenge.

In the [b][url=http://www.moveordiegame.com/contest]Level Building Contest[/url][/b] we want you to make a Move or Die Level Pack consisting of at least [b]5 Levels[/b].

Here's how to enter:
[list]
[*] [url=https://youtu.be/yNEqVQOHvc4]Watch this video[/url]
[*] [url=http://www.moveordiegame.com/LevelBuildingKit.zip]Download this Level Mod Kit[/url]
[*] [url=http://www.moveordiegame.com/modding/]Check out the modding wiki[/url]
[*] [b]Make 5 levels, one of which has to be a SpeedRun one.[/b]
[*] Submit your levels as one mod in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/323850/workshop/]Steam workshop[/url] page of Move or Die
[*] Tweet [url=https://twitter.com/someawesomeguys?lang=en]@someawesomeguys[/url] using the hashtag [b]#modcontest[/b] & link to the steam workshop page of your mod
-OR-
[*] Post the link on the Those Awesome Guys [url=https://www.facebook.com/ThoseAwesomeGuys/]Facebook page[/url], and mention @MoveOrDieGame in your Facebook post.
[*] Brag to your friends
[/list]

We will select 3 winners that will receive prizes based on their standings and overall quality. Any level or level pack that we consider amazing will make it into the game (as an official level), even if it wasn’t one of the winning 3!

The top 3 prizes are:
[list]
[*] 1st Place: [b]500 USD, a Move or Die 4 Pack and Yourself as a Hidden Character In the game[/b]
[*] 2nd Place: [b]200 USD, a Move or Die 4 Pack and your design for a trail in the game.[/b]
[*] 3rd Place: [b]100 USD and a Move or Die 4 Pack.[/b]
[/list]

[b]The Submission Deadline for this contest is the 17th of January at 23:59 GMT. Submit your entry before then.[/b]

Make sure you go through the official [b][url=https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/s/93lq9zw22ecare0/MoD%20Level%20Contest%20Legal.pdf]contest rules[/url][/b] to find out if you're eligible to enter.

Here's where all your minecraft experience comes in. Show us what you gooot!

~finch

notes.title: Announcing the Green & Gold Update!
notes.content:
[url=http://moveordiegame.com/updates/greenandgold/][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6909713/9eee3a180eed35ff00c7139fa796aeb59e275fec.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Ho Ho How's it hanging? [/h1]

Well the bells are now ringing, the hot chocolates are simmering and those large ugly sweaters are out of their drawer. It’s that most wonderful season that gives devs the best of reasons to update their games with snowy main menus and silly holiday lore.

Now this year, we made a proper list, checked it more than twice, trying to see how we could please as many of you as possible, regardless of being naughty or nice. 

We brought out our good wrapping paper and flashy ribbon bows for these special gifts, so here’s what you can expect in your stockings in just 7 days, on the 21st of December 2017

[*] Brand New In-Game Store (there’s tons of new stuff in there...and all of your old stuff too!)
[*] Customizable Trails for your Characters (give them duck trails, or fingernails or even coins that flip only tails!) 
[*] 7 Brand New Characters (which may include friends from the past and visions from the future!)
[*] A bunch of New Game Modes (some completely original, some others, not so much!)
[*] More than a couple of New Mutators (some of which you’ll love and some of which will annoy your friends to tears!)
[*] Online Mods for Friend Matches (YES! Steam Workshop mods are now playable in private lobbies against your friends!)
[*] And more™[/list]

[h1]Expect more details very soon before the update goes live on the 
ːstariteː[b]21st OF DECEMBER 2017ːstariteː[/b][/h1]

So boot up your voice chat, give your friends a call, there’s no more reason to keep hanging out at the mall. The Move or Die winter update is almost ready, and you should be too, it’s The [b]GREEN & GOLD[/b] standard of holiday gaming that was long overdue!


~finch

notes.title: Upcoming Item System Overhaul
notes.content:
[url=https://thoseawesomeguys.com/item-system-overhaul/][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6909713/f1e54cef23ff7f7836c412d56e9bf67fece18418.jpg[/img][/url]

[b]Hello there friends and hoarders![/b]

Recently we’ve been taking some good long looks in the mirror every morning and the general consensus was that we definitely need to cut down on the carbs. 

Also, some of our older implemented systems probably need a little grooming.

TL;DR:
[list]
 [*] We’re retiring the Steam-based item inventory system.
 [*] There’s gonna be a newly designed one WITHIN the actual game. 
 [*] Your current Move or Die items will be converted from Steam Inventory items to in-game items.
 [*] Progression remains strictly related to playing the game (put that sense of accomplishment back in your wallet).
 [*] No downtime between system shifts (you won't feel a thing).
 [*] You won’t loose anything and you will retain the value of current duplicates! (all items you had previously will be converted to the new system).
 [*] Reward system is also getting tweeks. Random rewards and unlocks will still be in, but future duplicates will still be useful through a new system.
 [*] Less confusion, more awesomeness!
 [*] It’s coming before the end of the year.
[/list]

There’s a new devblog up on our website that’s gonna walk you through the entire thought process behind our future changes and what you can expect in the coming weeks. 

[b][url=https://thoseawesomeguys.com/item-system-overhaul/]Read all about it![/url][/b]

Keep being awesome
~finch

notes.title: Announcing the DISCORD Mini-Update
notes.content:
[url=https://youtu.be/qsBjIxs64IQ][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6909713/613a8de74cff51087055e5224c7317607caa5128.png[/img][/url]

Hey there all you chatty Charlies!

We're super happy to announce the latest and greatest mini-update for Move or Die: 
[h1][url=https://youtu.be/qsBjIxs64IQ][b]The DISCORD Mini Update[/b][/url][/h1]

TL;DR Watch this video all about it:

https://youtu.be/qsBjIxs64IQ

This time, the most important changes come from our awesome partnership with the fantastic folks at [b][url=discord.gg]Discord[/url][/b], our (and we hope, yours too) favourite Voice Chat service out there.

Move or Die now has an official [b][url=www.discord.gg/moveordie]Discord Server[/url][/b] that you can join and chat with others playing the game.
The game also has Rich Presence within Discord, meaning you can see a ton of information about what your friends are doing in-game, and can easily join them directly through the app.

We've also created a special Bot on the server, called Mod Bot. You can ask it information about the game, your stats, and most importantly, you can now join in the [b]GIVEAWAYS[/b] for in-game loot that the Bot will sort out automatically, every day.

Last but not least, we've also got two brand new characters in the game: [b]Discord and Wumpus[/b]!

Here's a list of changes:

[list]
[*] Added Discord "Rich Presence" Integration
[*] Added the ability to join and invite friends to games through Discord
[*] Moved everything in the game 1 pixel to the left
[*] Added two new characters "Discord Logo" & "Wumpus"
[*] Added descriptions to Rick and Morty Characters
[/list]

Check out the [url=www.moveordiegame.com/patchnotes]patch notes here[/url].

Keep being awesome
~finch

notes.title: 6.0.3 Is here... more... small improvements!
notes.content:
We finally fixed some problems that were bugging us for months now.

We have added [b]8 new achievements[/b], improved the way the [b]game detects if you played the intro phase[/b] or not (you will no longer be forced to play it again from now on, sorry about that again), and we [b]influenced the way game modes are being randomly selected[/b] in order to create a better experience.

Oh, and we [b]removed the limit of max-game-modes in local games[/b], so you can now pick ALL of them!

Here is the full change log:
[list]
[*]Added 8 new achievements for the 4 new game modes (4 of which are daily missions)
[*]Changed the logic of the random "upcoming game mode" pick in order to make a better and more intense gameplay experience
[*]You can now pick more than 7 game modes in local games if you increase the time limit enough
[*]Fixed a bug where the game thought you didn't finish the introduction phase. Now it's based on the existence of XP on our server instead of a local variable
[*]Added the ability to go back to menu from the initial "introduction phase"
[*]Fixed the "Confusion" mutator not scrambling text in the "Waiting for other players" screen
[*]Fixed a crash related to online "Hat Chase"
[*]Fixed a visual bug where the timer white circle wouldn't appear if you would quit the previous match during sudden death
[*]Added better sound effects for "Static Bounce"
[*]Fixed a crash related to the controller rebinding buttons screen
[*]Fixed a bug in "Mind Control" introduced by the "Teams" mechanic
[*]Added controller assets above AI players during "Convention Mode"
[*]Fixed the depth of various in-game elements like the rocket in "Rocket Run" and the candies in "Sugar Rush" to be over the snow layer
[/list]

Oh, and remember, the game is still at [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/323850][b]50% OFF[/b][/url] during the Steam Winter Sale!

Keep being awesome, 
~ Nick (Xelu)

notes.title: Delay until January 2015
notes.content:
Hello everybody!...

[h1]Long story short[/h1]
Man, it sucks to have to do this, however, today [b]I had to make the decision of delaying the release date by a month.[/b]

The game is pushed back and will be released in the middle of January... this makes me more frustrated than you.

[h1]Why?[/h1]
The reason behind this delay is that, basically, the planets haven't aligned properly... the Steam Winter Sales are around the corner and releasing during that period would be suicidal, resulting in a complete overshadowing of the game. Aside from that, there is also the problem of the game needing a little more attention. I mean, sure, we could put it out next week, but I would rather have a bit more time to test out the latest implemented features, making sure the game won't explode and burn on launch.

[h1]Game Status[/h1]
For the past few weeks I've been working on some awesome things related to the release of the game, some nice videos and a really cool looking announcement page. However, all of those will have to wait a bit more. Game wise, we've been polishing the overall "playing online" experience and it needs some extra days of bug fixing for it to reach a rather stable state.

[b]After working 2 years on this, I don't really want to try my chances with an unstable build released during a major event[/b] and this makes it even harder for me because an extra month of development costs a lot more money, money that are quickly running out from my pocket... 

[h1]Ethics[/h1]
I could easily take the cheap route that is very common in this industry, called "pre-orders" to get quick funds for the game, but I don't think paying for a promise is a good idea and nobody should do that. Move or Die is developed for you guys and I want to make sure that by the time you get to buy it, you are absolutely sure of its quality. I would rather take the expensive risk of pushing the game back a month rather than releasing a sub-par version of it and I'm sure you guys understand that.

[b]Quality comes before money.[/b]

Having to be the one making these decisions sucks...
See you on the other side of the sales!

[i]~ Nick (Xelu)[/i]
